rows.label: Fighters to kill (scale)

write_rule.where: the called closure environment (per module instance)
write_rule.when: at every hooked entry: value == recorded instance value -> write; value == written -> skip; anything else -> fail closed (drift)
write_rule.cleanup: restore the recorded value in every live instance whose value is still the written one
write_rule.count: scale_count: a number, or every number of a plain list (written as a new list), times the setting, rounded to the nearest whole number and at least 1

limits.basis: operand domain guard only; gameplay-safe range not established offline

rows.confidence: CONFIRMED_STATIC (needs the environment argument; live pending)
rows.evidence: KillFightersExterminateEncounter proto 6 (readable L380-480): goal = netvar MinorKillGoal if set (host migration), else RandomInt(kuvaLichKillGoalMin, kuvaLichKillGoalMax) on a NemesisShowdown node, else RandomInt(minorKillGoals[i], minorKillGoalsMax[i]) for the first spaceLevelThresholds tier the space level reaches; published as netvar MinorKillGoal and _T.minorKillGoal. Proto 1 adds 1 per fighter kill; proto 9 completes the objective at kills/goal >= 1. The parameters come from the encounter type (H.Misc only; its Packages.bin text is empty). Capture graph: proto 6 <- proto 8 <- proto 9 (global KillFightersExterminateObjective).
